I'm Anna Avanesova, founder and director of Ada Tours. I create journeys across Brazil and Latin America where dreams become reality: a place on the map, a thoughtfully planned itinerary and a day you cannot wait to experience.

I first discovered Latin America at a time when independent travel there was unusual. I had a paper map, a compass and boundless enthusiasm. I headed into the unknown, met people, found my way and discovered places I longed to share. That curiosity has stayed with me. Today, it is joined by experience, personal connections and a team that can bring even the boldest ideas to life.

I speak 7 languages, have lived in 6 countries and travel around 20 times a year. I studied international business and have also explored many spiritual practices. I figure skate and compete internationally, dance and perform on stage. I love discovering new abilities, mastering difficult things and feeling the joy of turning an idea into reality.

I listen closely to people, sense what inspires them and enthusiastically look for ways to fulfil their wishes. I follow my own dreams with courage, and one of my greatest joys is creating journeys in which my guests' dreams come true.

My speciality is complex private itineraries, VIP travel and journeys that connect several countries in a single trip. I work with groups, MICE projects and tour operators. Every programme begins with real people: their dates, interests, habits, preferred level of comfort and personal vision of a wonderful holiday.

For my cherished VIP clients, I love dreaming up experiences that rarely come to mind when planning an ordinary journey.

Imagine a private breakfast among dazzling white dunes and clear lagoons stretching for hundreds of kilometres. All around you are silence, soft morning light and a table laid just for you. Or picture a jaguar resting on a riverbank as you watch from a boat, capybaras strolling peacefully near your villa, or a walk through the jungle where a tapir may appear among the greenery.

On another journey, you could snorkel in rivers so clear that every fish is visible, swim beneath waterfalls and then embark on your own journey towards the centre of the Earth: descending into a cave with stalactites and an underground lake. In one trip, you discover both the sunlit world of rivers and forests and the beauty hidden below.

You could fly in a private aircraft above a scattering of 300 tropical islands, then board a yacht, choose a quiet bay and dive into warm water. Or swim in your villa's pool and watch a volcano erupt in the distance while hummingbirds hover over flowers nearby.

In Patagonia, an ice trek awaits you, wearing special crampons among blue ice and deep crevasses. After the walk, a table is set especially for you for a private lunch right on the glacier. Only Ada Tours organises this particular lunch. Following your adventure on the ice, there is delicious food, thoughtful care and time to savour the surrounding beauty.

At the southernmost end of the continent, you can land by helicopter among the Andes and enjoy a cocktail chilled with ice from an ancient glacier. Elsewhere in Latin America, you can fly between the sheer walls of deep canyons and land on the heights for a picnic with a view that is hard to look away from.

Some evenings remain with you for a lifetime. Dinner inside a cave, followed by stepping out beneath a sky full of stars. A walk along a candlelit path in the Atacama Desert, a glass of pisco sour and an introduction to local cuisine before stargazing. Here in the high-altitude desert, you can spend hours looking up and gradually discovering more and more constellations.

And in the morning, another adventure begins. A seaplane landing on the waters of the Amazon and a luxurious lodge in the jungle. Ancient steps of a Maya city, temples, carved stelae and stories revealed by a local guide. A night among the traces of a vanished civilisation or close to a lost city, where you can hear the forest after dark and greet the sunrise before other travellers arrive.

Behind the effortless feel of such a journey lies meticulous work. I coordinate flights, boats and road transfers, select the right season, guides, villas and lodges, and leave room for rest. I want you to have the freedom to stay longer somewhere you love, change your plans, enjoy time together or embrace a new adventure.

Every Ada Tours journey is created with love and care. To me, luxury means personal attention, access to exceptional places and the feeling that your wishes have truly been heard. I want you to feel that care during a great adventure and over your morning coffee alike.

For you and your clients, I create journeys that surprise, inspire and sometimes change the way you see your own possibilities. Bold, exciting journeys with joyful evenings, profound experiences and days of complete relaxation. Trips that change your life and leave memories you will want to return to.

Your dream, made real.
